objective: Implement deterministic point-in-time Breakout / Expansion evidence using a prior-only price channel, with expansion retained as correlated confirmation context rather than a second vote.
scope: Define governed P08-F Breakout / Expansion policy
Validate a trusted single-symbol single-timeframe OHLCV window with consistent dataset and quality lineage
Build the breakout reference channel strictly from bars before the current bar
Detect upward/downward close breakouts beyond a governed channel buffer
Compute current-range expansion versus prior average candle range
Emit exactly one BREAKOUT TechnicalEvidence object per evaluation
Use expansion only as correlated strength/confidence context inside the breakout family
Bound strength and confidence as deterministic evidence scores rather than empirical probabilities
Reconcile P08-F task and lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Signal fusion, probability calibration, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none and active lock none before P08-F activation
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P08 source
Upward close beyond prior channel and buffer produces bullish BREAKOUT evidence
Downward close beyond prior channel and buffer produces bearish BREAKOUT evidence
Close inside prior channel produces neutral BREAKOUT evidence
Current bar is excluded from reference-channel construction
Expansion confirmation increases strength/confidence context but never creates a second independent vote
Breakout without expansion remains one valid breakout family event
Cross-family independence remains explicitly provisional pending P08-H
P08-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No execution adapter or broker/exchange/order authority is imported
No network or credential access is required
